name: rhino-mcp
description: MCP server for Rhino automation via an in-process plugin (RhinoMCPBridge) and local HTTP relay. Read/execute/update tool shape, matching the Fusion 360 connector rather than the SolidWorks one.

tools.name: rhino_connection_diagnostics
tools.description: Report the Rhino plugin's host PID, version, active document, and bridge listener status

tools.name: rhino_read
tools.description: Query-only: document info, object list, geometry/bounding box, viewport screenshot

tools.name: rhino_execute
tools.description: Run an arbitrary rhinoscriptsyntax/RhinoCommon Python snippet inside the plugin's main-thread context

tools.name: rhino_update
tools.description: Curated named operations: import/export, mesh-to-NURBS cleanup pipeline, silhouette extraction, extrude, scale, boolean ops
